arxiv-2306-01367.title: Testing the Paradigm of Nuclear Many-Body Theory
arxiv-2306-01367.creator: Omar Benhar
arxiv-2306-01367.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Omar Benhar. Nuclear many-body theory is based on the tenet that nuclear systems can be accurately described as collections of point-like particles. This picture, while providing a remarkably accurate explanation of a wealth of measured properties of atomic nuclei, is bound to break down in the high-density regime, in which degrees of freedom other than protons and neutrons are expected to come into play.

arxiv-2407-10631.title: Constraint on the total width of the Higgs boson from Higgs boson and four-top-quark measurements in p ​ p pp collisions at s \sqrt{s} = 13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2407-10631.description: Abstract This Letter presents a constraint on the total width of the Higgs boson ( Γ H \Gamma_{H} ) using a combined measurement of on-shell Higgs boson production and the production of four top quarks, which involves contributions from off-shell Higgs boson-mediated processes.

arxiv-2407-13047.title: A Novel GAN Approach to Augment Limited Tabular Data for Short-Term Substance Use Prediction
arxiv-2407-13047.creator: Nguyen Thach, Patrick Habecker, Bergen Johnston, Lillianna Cervantes, Anika Eisenbraun, Alex Mason, Kimberly Tyler, Bilal Khan, Hau Chan
arxiv-2407-13047.description: Abstract Substance use is a global issue that negatively impacts millions of persons who use drugs (PWUDs). In practice, identifying vulnerable PWUDs for efficient allocation of appropriate resources is challenging due to their complex use patterns (e.g., their tendency to change usage within months) and the high acquisition costs for collecting PWUD-focused substance use data.

arxiv-2503-09926.title: VideoMerge: Towards Training-free Long Video Generation
arxiv-2503-09926.creator: Siyang Zhang, Harry Yang, Ser-Nam Lim
arxiv-2503-09926.description: Abstract Long video generation remains a challenging and compelling topic in computer vision. Diffusion‐based models, among the various approaches to video generation, have achieved state‐of‐the‐art quality with their iterative denoising procedures. However, the intrinsic complexity of the video domain renders the training of such diffusion models exceedingly expensive in terms of both data curation and computational resources.

arxiv-2508-21372.description: Abstract We consider the following inference problem: Given a set of edge-flow signals observed on a graph, lift the graph to a cell complex, such that the observed edge-flow signals can be represented as a sparse combination of gradient and curl flows on the cell complex.

britannica-1911-vivero.description: Article 'Vivero' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of Lugo; on the Ria de Vivero, an estuary formed by the river Landrove, which here enters the Bay of Biscay. Vivero is an old-fashioned and picturesque town, connected with the opposite bank of the estuary by a bridge of twelve arches and a causeway. Its fishing fleet, its coasting trade and the agricultural products of the fertile country around are important.

pmc-10700041.title: Application of Interpretable Machine Learning Models Based on Ultrasonic Radiomics for Predicting the Risk of Fibrosis Progression in Diabetic Patients with Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease
pmc-10700041.creator: Fei Meng, Qin Wu, Wei Zhang, Shirong Hou
pmc-10700041.description: IntroductionPatients with nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) face a significant risk of hepatic fibrosis. Liver stiffness measurement (LSM) is commonly used to exclude advanced fibrosis, but its effectiveness in predicting fibrosis progression, especially in initially fibrosis-free patients, remains under-investigated.

pmc-11392829.title: Unlocking reproducible transcriptomic signatures for acute myeloid leukaemia: Integration, classification and drug repurposing
pmc-11392829.creator: Haoran Chen, Jinqi Lu, Zining Wang, Shengnan Wu, Shengxiao Zhang, Jie Geng, Chuandong Hou, Peifeng He, Xuechun Lu
pmc-11392829.description: Acute myeloid leukaemia (AML) is a highly heterogeneous disease, which lead to various findings in transcriptomic research. This study addresses these challenges by integrating 34 datasets, including 26 control groups, 6 prognostic datasets and 2 single‐cell RNA sequencing (scRNA‐seq) datasets to identify 10,000 AML‐related genes (ARGs).

pmc-11681509.title: From Jargon to Clarity. Improving the Readability of Foot and Ankle Radiology Reports with An Artificial Intelligence Large Language Model
pmc-11681509.creator: James J. Butler, Michael Harrington, Yixuan Tong, Andrew Rosenbaum, Alan P. Samsonov, Raymond J. Walls, John G. Kennedy
pmc-11681509.description: Category:Other; AnkleIntroduction/Purpose:The purpose of this study was to evaluate the efficacy of an Artificial Intelligence Large Language Model (AI-LLM) at improving the readability foot and ankle orthopedic radiology reports.Methods:The radiology reports from 100 foot or ankle X-Rays, 100 computed tomography (CT) scans and 100 magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans were randomly sampled from the institution’s database.

pmc-12376385.title: Adverse Events and Immune Response in Psoriasis Patients Receiving Interleukin-17 Inhibitors
pmc-12376385.creator: Christopher Willy SCHWARZ, Charlotte NÄSLUND-KOCH, Claus ZACHARIAE, Jakob Benedict SEIDELIN, Susanne Dam NIELSEN, Sisse Rye OSTROWSKI, Karen Marie THYSSEN ASTVAD, Inger BROCK, Lars IVERSEN, Mads Kirchheiner RASMUSSEN, Nikolai LOFT, Lone SKOV
pmc-12376385.description: Interleukin-17 inhibitors are effective in psoriasis; however, they are associated with an increased risk of infections, particularly oral candidiasis, and new-onset/flares of inflammatory bowel disease. This study aimed to identify predictive markers for these adverse events and to describe the functional immune response in patients treated with interleukin-17 inhibitors using a whole-blood stimulation system (TruCulture®).

pmc-12449724.title: Male Glow‐Worms Combine Flying With Walking and Impede One Another in Their Scramble to Reach Females
pmc-12449724.creator: Estelle M. Moubarak, Alan J. A. Stewart, Jeremy E. Niven
pmc-12449724.description: For male glow‐worms to achieve a mating, they must detect the bioluminescent glow emitted by females at night and subsequently reach them. Several aspects of male behaviour suggest they engage in scramble competition, with many males striving simultaneously to reach a female first and acquire a mating opportunity.

pmc-12454977.title: Death caused by transdermal ivermectin poisoning: A case report and literature review
pmc-12454977.creator: He Yin, Peng-Shu Zhang, Yu Chen, Bing-Bing Kong, Chen-Guang Zhang, Sheng Wu
pmc-12454977.description: Ivermectin is a classic antiparasitic drug that is widely used around the world. After the outbreak of coronavirus disease 2019, many studies have reported the potential effectiveness of ivermectin against coronavirus disease 2019; however, it is not recommended by the World Health Organization because of insufficient evidence and significant adverse effects.

pmc-12562243.title: Exploring the Abnormal Characteristics of the Ovaries During the Estrus Period of Kazakh Horses Based on Single-Cell Transcriptome Technology
pmc-12562243.creator: Wanlu Ren, Jun Zhou, Jianping Zhu, Jianguang Zhang, Xueguang Zhao, Xinkui Yao, Jacek Z Kubiak
pmc-12562243.description: Simple SummaryThe growth and development of the ovaries in horses is a highly complex biological process. During the development of the ovaries, some individuals may show abnormal development, which makes the breeding work for horses very challenging. Therefore, in order to explore this complex issue, we used single-cell transcriptome sequencing technology to analyze 10 samples.

pmc-13170209.description: Biologics have gained prominence as a rapidly advancing therapeutic modality for a diverse spectrum of medical conditions. Additionally, repeated injections of biologics such as insulin cause injection pain, leading to dose‐skipping and poor medication adherence.

pmc-13585667.title: Public Understanding of Wastewater Surveillance, United States, August 2025
pmc-13585667.creator: Rieza H. Soelaeman, Diana Valencia, Jena Losch, Danielle Kleven, Jazmyn Moore, Scott Santibañez
pmc-13585667.description: We examined public understanding of wastewater surveillance (WS) data and perceptions of its importance by using a nationwide cross-sectional survey.
